annotations.title: GEO check of a page for AI assistants

description: Runs the GEO SEO Records engine on a public page and returns the gaps, weighted blocking / important / to decide, across six parts: the door (robots.txt rules for the robots that read for a person), the map (llms.txt present and verifiable), the answer (does the page answer under its title, declared questions), the citable (figures with a source or a date), the publisher identity, and the structure (blocks that stay true when quoted alone). Requires this connector's access pass (€9.90 for 24 hours, or €29 per month). Docs: https://seorecords.com/assistants

access_key.description: Access key (pass_…) of this connector, shown after buying its 24-hour pass or monthly subscription. Required.
